Warnings array is empty for complex but valid HTML

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>

#include "html_to_markdown.h"

    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<article><h1>Article</h1><p>Paragraph with <strong>bold</strong> and <em>italic</em>.</p><table><tr><th>Col</th></tr><tr><td>Val</td></tr></table><ul><li>Item 1</li><li>Item 2</li></ul></article>", 0);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
